past.body:
Fourth Annual Spring Car Show

Saturday, May 16th, 2026 | 10a-3p

Located at Real Life Church | 900 Centerville Turnpike N, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Mark your 2026 calendars! – Real Life Christian Church and Rummel’s Automotive will be hosting our FOURTH Annual Spring Car Show on Saturday, May 16 at Real Life Church in Chesapeake, VA. Our shows always fill our parking lot with fantastic cars and friendly people. Our Spring ‘26 event will once again feature music, food, vendors, raffles, giveaways and we’ll be awarding LOTS of trophies among all vehicle types. More details to follow in upcoming months, but be sure to plan on coming to our Fourth Annual show on May 16th!

past.title: MCT Spring Fling Mustang Birthday Show | April 18th
past.body:
The Mustang Club of Tidewater’s Annual Spring Fling Mustang Birthday Car Show - All Makes and Models Welcome!!!

Date: Saturday, April 18th, 2026 | 9a-2p

Location: Cavalier Ford Greenbrier - 1515 S. Military Highway, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Click on the header image to see the entire show flyer!

Details:
• This is a Participant's Choice show, with 25 Participant’s Choice awards, and 4 top awards for Best in Show, Dealer’s Choice, Charity's Choice, and Club/Group Participation.
• Open to all years, makes and models of passenger cars, trucks, and motorcycles. Come show us what you have!!!
• This is a family friendly event, so feel free to bring the kids so they can enjoy the show! Bring your cameras!
• There is no charge for spectators, but they must park adjacent to but not in the show field, as directed.
• There will be food vendors on-site and hot dogs & chips provided by Cavalier Ford.
• 50/50 tickets will be sold during the show with winners of various prizes chosen during awards.
• Please be respectful of our host, Cavalier Ford Greenbrier. NO loud music/bass, engine revving, or exhibitions of speed at or departing the show by attendees.

Schedule:
• 9:00 - Registration Opens
• 10:00 - Driver's Meeting / Judging Begins
• 12:00 - Registration Closed
• 12:30 - Judging Ends / Votes Counted
• 1:30 - Car Show Awards Presented and 50/50 Winners announced
• 2:00 - Show Ends

past.title: 8th Annual George E Smith Memorial Car Show and Swap Meet | Mar 28th
past.body:
8th Annual George E Smith Memorial Car Show and Swap Meet

Saturday, March 28 | 10a-3p

Register Here

Join us as we celebrate the memory of a local car enthusiast who passed away December 28, 2018. George was a vital part of the Landstown Cruise-Ins, and we are proud to remember him with an annual event. George also served on the board of the Beachcomber Corvette Club served as the president of the Car Club Council of Hampton Roads.

This will be an all years, makes, and models event with awards. Beach Restomods is hosting a Swap Meet in the lot in conjunction with the show benefitting charity!

Portion of proceeds will benefit a charity that George believed in, the Southeastern Food Bank. We will be accepting all non perishable food items for the food bank. Proceeds will also benefit the Car Club Council of Hampton Roads as we work on improved events for all of our attendees.

This event is hosted by 757 Auto Events and the Car Club Council of Hampton Roads.
